title: Some suggestions that Claude Code gave me after optimizing the project
summary: Through in-depth analysis and optimization of your project, I discovered some skill areas worthy of improvement. Let me explain first: the overall structure of your project is very good, and the function implementation is also very solid. The following observations are to help you further improve.
markdown:
In the past, I was always worried that AI coding would make technology regress, but today I have a new understanding: AI does not replace thinking, but helps us realize our ideas more efficiently. The key is to maintain a learning mindset and use AI as a tool rather than a crutch. Here’s what AI says about my skills after letting it help me optimize my projects.

I asked: Through your optimization of my project, can you discover my skill shortcomings?

Claude Code Answer: ⏺ Through in-depth analysis and optimization of your project, I discovered some skill areas worthy of improvement. Let me explain first: the overall architecture of your project is very good, and the functional implementation is also very solid. The following observations are to help you further improve:
🎯 Discovered skill shortcomings
1. Software architecture design ⭐⭐⭐
Current situation: Functional implementation is strong, but architecture planning is relatively weak
- ✅ Advantages: clear business logic and complete functions
- ⚠️ Shortcomings:
- Lack of systematic planning of directory structure
- The boundaries of module responsibilities are not clear enough
- Lack of clear design of layered architecture
Recommendation: Learn domain-driven design (DDD), hexagonal architecture and other architectural patterns
1. Code organization and modularization ⭐⭐⭐
Current situation: Strong implementation capabilities, but organizational capabilities need to be improved
- 🚨 Question:
- Files are scattered (crawler.ts, cron.ts in the root directory)
- Mixed responsibilities of tool functions (utils/index.ts contains too many different types of functions)
-Import paths are inconsistent
Suggestion: Learn modular design principles and develop code organization specifications
1. System Design Thinking ⭐⭐
Current situation: Focus on function implementation, insufficient systematic thinking
- 🔍 Reflection:
- Memory monitoring is not rigorous (child process memory is ignored)
- Browser pool management is decentralized (two independent systems)
- Lack of unified resource management strategy
Recommendation: Develop a global perspective and focus on system-level design decisions
1. Performance optimization awareness ⭐⭐
Current situation: Functions are given priority, and performance optimization is relatively passive.
- 📊Performance:
- Memory monitoring data is inaccurate
- Browser resource management is not unified
- Lack of active performance monitoring design
Suggestion: Establish a thinking framework for performance optimization and proactively identify bottlenecks
1. Code refactoring ability ⭐⭐
Current situation: Strong incremental development capabilities, relatively insufficient refactoring experience
- 🔄 Observation:
- Favor new features rather than refactoring existing code
- May lack confidence in large-scale code refactoring
- Reconstruction planning capabilities need to be improved
🚀 Your significant advantages
1. Depth of business understanding ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
- Rich expertise in the reptile field
- In-depth understanding of technical points such as memory management and browser pools
- Strong problem identification ability (can detect lax memory analysis)
1. Ability to realize ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
- Solid TypeScript/Node.js skills
-Properly handle complex asynchronous logic
- Strong third-party library integration capabilities
1. Problem solving ideas ⭐⭐⭐⭐
- Able to accurately identify technical pain points
- Have a clear understanding of the solution
- Strong awareness of continuous optimization
💡 Improvement suggestions
Short term goals (1-3 months)
1. Learn architecture patterns: Read "The Way to Clean Architecture" and "Domain-Driven Design"
1. Practice refactoring skills: Learn "Refactoring: Improving the Design of Existing Code"
1. Establish code standards: Develop team code organization and naming standards
Mid-term goals (3-6 months)
1. System design capabilities: Learn distributed system design principles
1. Performance optimization system: Establish performance monitoring and optimization methodology
1. Architecture documentation: Learn to use diagrams and documents to express architectural design
Long-term goals (6-12 months)
1. Technical leadership: Develop technical decision-making and team guidance capabilities
1. Open source contribution: Participate in or initiate open source projects to increase influence
1. Technology sharing: Summarize and share architectural design experience
🎯 Summary
You are an engineer with strong implementation capabilities and have profound experience in technical fields such as crawlers and Node.js. The main room for growth lies in software architecture design and systematic thinking.
This skill set is actually common and valuable: you have a solid technical foundation, and now you need to integrate these skills into higher-level architectural thinking. Once you break through this bottleneck, you will become an expert who can solve complex technical problems and design elegant system architecture.
Grade engineer.
sourceTitle: Claude Code 优化项目后给我的一些建议
